ammonia.reason: Low deamination and urease activity in 30-day pasteurized cheese with limited proteolysis.

animal_barnyard.reason: Low p-cresol/indole from pasteurized ewe milk and starter, no stable contamination.

bitter.reason: Low accumulation of hydrophobic bitter peptides from chymosin and NSLAB in young curd.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation and no methyl ketone blue-mold pathway.

browning.reason: Limited Maillard due to low residual lactose and short 30-day ripening.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from citrate metabolism by Lactococcus lactis starter culture.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Low butanoic/hexanoic acids from limited calf rennet-paste lipolysis in young cheese.

creaminess.reason: Fat ~28% with hydrated para-casein and intact milk fat gives smooth mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: High moisture 39.5% and limited proteolysis keep matrix cohesive, not fracturable.

firmness.reason: Moisture 39.5% with pH 5.4 calcium-retained rennet gel gives semi-firm elastic body.

floral_honey.reason: Low phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from limited phenylalanine Strecker degradation.

fruity.reason: Low ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from limited esterase activity in 30-day pasteurized curd.

goaty.reason: Moderate caproic/caprylic/capric acids characteristic of ewe milk triglycerides.

malty_nutty.reason: Low 3-methylbutanal/2-methylpropanal from Strecker and low propanal in young cheese.

melt.reason: pH 5.4 demineralized rennet network with 39.5% moisture flows moderately on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Trace 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one from linoleate lipoxygenase, no rind flora.

oil_off.reason: Moderate free oil release from sheep milk fat on heating, not excessive coalescence.

smoky.reason: No smoke application and no guaiacol/phenol formation during make.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic and trace acetic acid from starter fermentation to pH 5.4.

stretch.reason: Rennet-coagulated, non pasta-filata curd lacks aligned demineralized casein fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Low H2S/methional from pasteurization 73C and limited methionine catabolism.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose, galactose and low acid mask bitterness in young sweet pecorino.

umami.reason: Low free glutamate from limited chymosin/plasmin proteolysis at 30 days.
